items.title: Beijing's centenarian record puts focus on eldercare
items.description: Beijing's centenarian population reached a record 1,801 by the end of 2025, an increase of 262 from a year earlier, highlighting the capital's growing elderly population and the need to expand senior care services, according to an official report released on Wednesday.

items.title: Move to spur green power consumption
items.description: China is considering imposing fines equivalent to five to 10 times the cost of green electricity certificates needed to cover any shortfall on entities that fail to meet mandatory renewable electricity consumption targets, according to a draft revision to the Renewable Energy Law submitted to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the country's top legislature, for a first reading on Monday.
